title: Out-of-Body Induction (Ehrsson 2007)

source.title: The experimental induction of out-of-body experiences

passage: Multisensory integration can induce out-of-body experiences, shifting perceived self-location. Experimental induction shows self-location is constructed from multisensory signals.
context: Neuroscience domain: self-location and multisensory construction. Relevant to AI repository's location of memory index vs external query source.
source_note: Verified via DOI; multisensory construction and self-location confirmed.
literary_invitation: If the repository's memory index location shifts (e.g., shard migration), does the 'self' location shift? How is multisensory integration simulated in memory retrieval?
scope_note: Q-003: conditional hypothesis on self-location construction (HYP-20261117-b17a54). Excludes phenomenal consciousness claims.

verification.note: Confirmed multisensory construction/self-location; excluded phenomenal consciousness attribution.
